scope: Selective primary-source update, not a systematic review. Existing PubMed citation identities and correction/retraction metadata checked. Broad name searches and a follow-up title/abstract screen returned candidate titles; selected relevant original-study abstracts were appraised. False-positive names, reviews, protocols, case reports, and animal models were not treated as controlled human efficacy evidence. Profile dates are changed only where selected scientific or official sources were appraised.

search_limits.followup_excludes: Review, Systematic Review, Meta-Analysis publication types (indexing is imperfect)
search_limits.limitation: Capped name searches are not exhaustive; recent publication indexing, synonyms, full text, supplements, all indications, and every adverse-event source may be missed. Blends are assessed through named components and exact-combination evidence limits.
